workflow: Built-in image_gen; original fictional garden and transparent compositing assets. Generated 19 October 2026.

Camera completely level and fixed, seated eye height from a first-floor English country house study, looking outward across a VAST beautifully maintained early Victorian/Regency English estate garden, Jane Austen atmosphere. Do NOT include a desk, interior, window frame or glass: those are separate app layers. Foreground broad garden lawn, symmetrical gravel paths, low clipped box hedges, rose borders and a central small stone fountain with clearly visible water basin. They converse on garden paths. Far background a graceful limestone country manor, rolling English parkland, mature trees. Soft late-afternoon daylight with natural photographic greens, pale blue sky taking the top 25%, subtle high clouds, realistic photographic texture and depth, tranquil refined atmosphere. Garden occupies most of frame. No crowds, no cars, no modern clothing, no text, no logos, no illustration or painterly look. All architecture firmly static. Clear distant viewpoint appropriate to someone sitting in their study.
